goal: Freshly regenerate and independently verify the large VN studio through the existing reviewed provider route after removing prior generated outputs; eliminate owner-timeout truncation across manifest, leaf, review, and transport layers without expanding context or adding a generation route.
acceptance_criteria: Background and character-sprite generation are separate executable workflows that create distinct decodable image artifacts from user prompts and expose honest local-model or hosted-provider configuration checks.
Generated assets can be selected by characters or scenes and attached to story nodes without duplicating the story model in frontend and backend modules.

Generated-project unit, contract, integration, runtime, browser, accessibility, media-decoding, and design-quality checks pass or produce an evidence-backed canonical blocker rather than a false success.
The generated project contains docs-first product, architecture, interaction, image-generation, story-schema, quality, and test documentation plus a modular src and tests layout.
The test uses the existing reviewed Provider component route with design research, bounded librarian context, module validation, post-build finalization, and no alternate generator.
Users can create, edit, connect, branch, delete, persist, reload, and preview story nodes through one typed story-tree model.

Deterministic UI adapters never synthesize visible product nodes, controls, result surfaces, status copy, behavior, or styling; missing interfaces remain Provider repair failures, and caches created under an older adapter policy are not reusable.

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

interface_expectations: Frontend repair leaves use accepted HTML projections for exact DOM actions, CSS ownership, media selectors, canvas preview behavior, and measurable desktop region width.
The post-build librarian supplies one candidate-only repair source body plus bounded interface contracts; duplicated sibling/rejected source text is not sent to the local model.
Browser evidence exercises the preview action before measuring blank/flat canvas pixels and independently measures multi-row layout, region width, header treatment, and browser-default controls.
The UI semantic adapter may reconcile only exact existing ownership interfaces; it cannot manufacture customer-visible completeness or redirect absent DOM owners into a generic status surface.

feedback: Generated pytest remains passing at 26 passed and 13 skipped; the executable fixture and decoder-valid distinct image checks pass.
Machine visual checks now reject the previously false-positive single-column, narrow-card, blank-canvas, flat-canvas, unthemed-header, and browser-default-button conditions.
Manual review still rejects the current VN surface and generated artwork as default/placeholder-like; no package or delivery PASS was produced.

qwen2.5-coder:7b repeatedly returned the same single-fillRect preview after the prompt was reduced to one source body and given an exact structured canvas contract; a stronger code provider or model is required for the remaining generated-project repair.

Root-cause review found that the deterministic UI semantic adapter itself had crossed the generation boundary by inserting sample graph nodes, capability controls, result outputs, initial status copy, and a CSS hit-target rule, while collapsing missing JavaScript owners into one status target. The adapter is now ownership-only and legacy accepted/rejected frontend leaf caches are isolated by policy version.

Focused adapter, cache-isolation, and kernel-contract tests pass. The broader related profile reports 201 passed, 135 skipped, and 3 pre-existing failures in unrelated media-fixture error precedence, implementation-depth payload shape, and component-quality affected-file selection; no delivery status was promoted.

The 2026-09-03 live Provider attempt reached the configured endpoint but was blocked: the default model returned MODEL_NOT_FOUND, and qwen3.8-max returned HTTP 403 PERMISSION_DENIED because the free quota was exhausted or free-tier-only mode remained enabled. No generated candidate, package, or delivery PASS was produced.

The real-project harness now uses the Codex conversation contract and maps the captured Provider permission failure to BLOCKED_PROVIDER; focused regression groups report 87 passed, 46 passed, and 16 passed.
Alternative Qwen probes restored Provider access: qwen3-coder-plus, qwen3.7-plus, and qwen3.5-plus each returned valid structured smoke responses, while qwen3.8-27b did not.

Fresh full runs with qwen3-coder-plus and qwen3.7-plus both stopped at requirement_decision_needs_rework with an insufficient canonical goal/project plan; implementation, runtime, visual, packaging, and delivery evidence remained unevaluated or absent.
The harness now maps a canonical rework_blocked generation or NEEDS_REWORK delivery gate to formal NEEDS_REWORK; the updated focused regression group reports 17 passed.
Standalone VN recognition and generic visual-component ownership were corrected without adding a generation path; the related planning, complexity, acceptance, and kernel profile reports 149 passed.

The qwen3-coder-plus v7 run passed canonical planning and routed all 54 Provider requests to the requested model with no fallback, but exhausted structured repair output for src/character_editor.py after recording 46 leaf completions; no candidate or delivery was promoted.

The qwen3.7-plus v8 run stopped on repeated remote disconnect/refusal during the foundation manifest, while the qwen3.5-plus v9 bounded run repeatedly timed out and became dependent on local qwen2.5-coder fallback; neither provides end-to-end delivery evidence.

worked: Candidate-only accepted-leaf reuse plus exact HTML-derived interface projections reduced repair scope without writing partial atomic sets.
Monotonic rejected-candidate ranking preserved near-pass CSS instead of regressing to the latest structurally worse output.
Browser workflow execution and computed geometry/style/pixel diagnostics converted manual design findings into reproducible quality failures.
Separating generated product truth from deterministic interface normalization removed a false-completeness mechanism without adding another generation path.

Keeping Provider reachability, generated-candidate evidence, packaging, and delivery authority separate prevented a reachable but quota-blocked endpoint from being reported as a successful real-project test.
A two-run structured smoke check identified stable Qwen candidates cheaply before full generation attempts, and the quality gate consistently rejected insufficient project plans.
did_not_work: Repeated prose instructions alone did not make the 7B local model change a single solid canvas drawing into a content-bearing preview.
Token declaration counts and non-empty canvas pixels were too weak and allowed default browser styling plus a blue rectangle to pass.
A deterministic adapter that inserted visible sample content made structural checks easier to satisfy while reducing confidence that the Provider authored the product behavior.
The configured Provider account could not execute either the default model or qwen3.8-max, so fresh candidate, runtime, browser, and media evidence could not be collected.
Changing to available Qwen models removed the Provider-access blocker but did not produce the canonical requirement plan needed to start implementation.

After the canonical planning correction, no tested Qwen model completed the full governed route: coder-plus failed repeated structured repair output, and the plus models were transport-unstable at project payload sizes.
experiments: Resume the same affected JS/CSS repair with a stronger reviewed provider while keeping the single-source librarian slice and all new gates unchanged.
Track semantic-adapter policy provenance on every cached frontend leaf and reject policy-less or older records before librarian retrieval or accepted-leaf reuse.
After Provider access is restored, rerun the same fresh Codex conversation E2E with the current gates and do not reuse this blocked attempt as PASS evidence.
Inspect the requirement-planning prompt, Provider response projection, and canonical goal-plan parser using the qwen3-coder-plus and qwen3.7-plus run evidence before another paid full run.

Keep the corrected plan and component ownership fixed, then evaluate a Provider/model combination that can sustain 20k-30k character structured code-repair prompts without transport timeouts or non-JSON responses.
